conflicts.question: Should Repo have one local-path-only grammar, or allow owner/name plus path? Hermes forbids the remote on that line; other copies/templates accept broader forms. Recommend one parseable local-path field plus separate remote metadata.

Should every surface follow the saved reviewable-draft/revision workflow when requested, with path/timezone/notification bindings, or retain this only for Hermes? Recommend the conditional workflow shared, not unconditional outbound sends.
SECURITY: remove the plugin exception permitting merge/deploy/Done when a spec permits it? Recommend remove; replace with the unconditional Build stage boundary. No secrets restriction is dropped.

Does missing configured live proof allow an explicitly incomplete In Review handoff, as Hermes says, or must verification finish before proceeding, as canonical says? Recommend honest review handoff only when the unavailable operator path is expressly allowed by the spec.

SECURITY: remove Hermes direct GraphQL/LINEAR_API_KEY advice, including its reference echo, which conflicts with NO-BOT-TOKEN/no-hand-rolled-HTTP? Recommend connected tools only and stop on unavailable writes.

Can a reproduced unrelated baseline failure be non-blocking when any red PR check otherwise requires FAIL? Recommend never waive a red PR check; separately report baseline local failures without treating them as a pass.

SECURITY: what is the supported isolated-profile preflight and re-mint policy after WD-547? F requires isolation before viewer; H has viewer alone. Recommend preserve F isolation as a required profile overlay; do not copy live credential access into other stages.
Should the isolated Integrate copy receive the missing autonomous-run override? Recommend shared override, while retaining its stricter isolation preflight.

Some pickup wording still says skip silently while the no-silent-skip block requires diagnostics. Recommend the newer, explicit diagnostic exceptions and exact CI-capacity/race silence win on every surface.

May a late reviewer post new proof after another reviewer finishes, as the Hermes race reference allows, while plugin wording simply says back off? Recommend no duplicate or state mutation, with a clearly labeled materially-new-evidence follow-up only.

SECURITY: should historical generic relay/signed/rebased-approval examples be explicitly scoped to product-under-test, never Factory merge approval? Recommend yes; Factory approval remains only the pinned Discord verifier and exact reviewed head.

Should reference examples using force removal, broad stop/kill wording or cleanup-before-Linear be narrowed to clean owned worktrees/processes after evidence preservation? Recommend the common stage cleanup order and no runtime/unowned-process termination.

example_policy: Lossless baseline rendering. No semantic changes, stale removals or conflict decisions applied before Jonathan sign-off.
